steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Scholar, get up a tree, quick! There's a herd of hornbeasts coming!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There's no time! Yato!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm doing what I can!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow! Something stinky fur mew!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Arty, what did you just throw?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Blegh! Stinks like hell! Did those fowlbeasts come back again?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's having an effect! The herd is changing direction!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What did you use, Artisan?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Fowlbeast, stinky! Made Dung Bomb!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ah, so that was it! Of course my little Smithy would be able to craft a Dung Bomb from droppings so quickly!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: If you throw a Dung Bomb onto a monster, they won't be able to stand the smell and will run away from mew, just like us with Noir Corne earlier.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, no using me as an example!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Even though they changed directions, they're still rampaging through the forest. This will be troublesome if the Rathalos tracks get trampled over.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Rampaging hornbeasts... I feel like that's definitely out of the ordinary. Why would they go berserk for no reason?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It doesn't matter, we just need to stop them.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: With my expurrtise, I postulate that there must be a lead hornbeast at the front to make such a huge herd move like that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Really now? If that's the case, then we'll just have to cut it down.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait, what do you mean by 'just have to cut it down'?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What part of that was hard to understand?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: And how exactly do you plan to do that, huh?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Just charge right in.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There's so many of them and they're all in a frenzy... You sure about that? We don't even know why they're going crazy.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And will they wait for us to sit down and figure out the cause? Cover me.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait up! Arty, do you still have that, uh... Dung Bomb?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: So much stinky! Fur mew!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Scholar, I just want to make sure... If I can land this on the lead hornbeast, is it possible the rest of them will disperse?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Based to their purr-evious reaction... In theory.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But pawbably not fur long! And you have to aim from up close to make sure it hits the right one.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Aight, I think I got something. I'll try and aim for it from up here on the tree.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, when the other hornbeasts scatter, take the chance and subdue the leader in one strike!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Of course I will.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But this means you'll...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Get even stinkier? Eh, couldn't be any worse—yuck!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: There's... still time...
They are too fast, too young, too powerful, too difficult to control.
The past once suppressed surges forth, yet the danger of the forest has never abated.
You have lost control, broken your body, made too many mistakes.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No... that's not the reason.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: We must keep up the chase.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ah, isn't that...?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Over there! I spotted it!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Right in furont of the stampede, the one with bigger horns and a yellow sheen to its fur, that should be the lead beast!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's heading here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I can do this, I can do this...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Focus.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They're almost here, get ready.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait... I think I dropped my nose plug.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh? Argh! Forget it!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Super Dung Bomb Attack! Right on target!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: —Haah!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Did you get it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Sure enough, the herd has calmed down quite a bit.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne, you...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yes, I know! I stink like hell, I'll get away from you guys!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, you're hurt.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh, this scratch? It's nothing.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's a good thing I had a spare first aid kit. Come over here and I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah... O-Okay.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Come over quick, the two of mew.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: See here? The nose of the lead beast has traces of a grayish white dust here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Uh, this looks familiar...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Back home, there is a species of fauna known as a Stinkmink that can release a cloud of pheromones, sending meownsters into a frenzy and charging straight into mew.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Our Hunters make use of that effect in their hunts.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah, now I remember... I saw bottles of this stuff at that Kashiwau's place, could it be...?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I'm pawsitive.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did he know we entered the forest and agitate the hornbeasts with the dust to cut us off?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He did say 'Don't ever let me see you there—'

spans.text: say 'Don't ever let me see you there—'

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, that can't be it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He was already in the forest by yesterday afternoon, while we only arrived here after the incident in the cave, so he shouldn't know our whereabouts.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He couldn't have seen us in the forest either; there's no way I wouldn't have spotted him first.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: True enough, and I guess if his motive was to find the Rathalos, he wouldn't want to risk losing its tracks either, by triggering such a stampede.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Lemme think... Or maybe he planned to do something else with the herd, but lost control of it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...You're thinking about pointless things again. We have a beast to track.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: This is bad! Smithy's gone again!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: We were together in the tree earlier, but when we came down...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ahhh! I won't go through that ever again... never!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrrow...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I think I heard a Felyne over there.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ah! Smithy! What happened to mew?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Seems like... he got stunned by the stink.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I can only hope this will be the worst of it.
Today's sun is setting.
Look...The light between the leaves wavers, while their rustling in the darkness grows ever louder.
A momentary impulse... O beasts who have gone astray.
You will not return from the darkness of the forest.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Shut up...

a.text: Our equipment...has been sabotaged...unable to display normally...
